mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.album_name, a.description, a.album_cover, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_album_images pai WHERE pai.album_id = a.id) AS photo_count FROM photo_album a WHERE a.is_visible = 1 ORDER BY a.sort_order ASC, a.created_at DESC

SELECT i.id AS imageId, i.file_path AS filePath, i.file_name AS fileName, pai.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM photo_album_images pai JOIN images i ON i.id = pai.image_id WHERE pai.album_id = #{albumId} ORDER BY pai.sort_order ASC, pai.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo_album (album_name, description, album_cover, sort_order, is_visible) VALUES (#{albumName}, #{description}, #{albumCover}, #{sortOrder}, #{isVisible})
INSERT IGNORE INTO photo_album_images (album_id, image_id) VALUES (#{albumId}, #{imageId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM photo_album_images WHERE album_id = #{albumId} AND image_id = #{imageId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_album_images WHERE album_id = #{albumId}
